2014_spells.eldritch-blast.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage. The spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three beams at 11th level, and four beams at 17th level. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.
2014_spells.eldritch-blast.effectSummary: Deal 1d10 force damage to a target within 120 ft
2014_spells.eldritch-blast.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, the spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three beams at 11th level, and four beams at 17th level. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage; Make a separate attack roll for each beam. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
